english.title: Used premises for special treatment otherwise than in accordance with the terms of the licence in London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[the licence holder under Part II of the London Local Authorities Act 1991 at premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),]_
(B)_[the applicant for the transfer of a special treatment licence under Part II of the London Local Authorities Act 1991 for premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) where you were carrying out the functions to which the licence related,]_
(C)_[a person concerned in the conduct or management of the premises licenced under Part II of the London Local Authorities Act 1991, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),]_

when the premises were used as an establishment for special treatment otherwise than in accordance with the terms, conditions or restrictions on or subject to which the licence was held, namely **(..SPECIFY USE OF PREMISES..) in breach of **(..SPECIFY TERMS, CONDITIONS OR RESTRICTIONS...)
english.legislation: Contrary to section14(2) of the London Local Authorities Act 1991.
